decision.observation: 13 mph, gear 1, dots pale, red X gone. The car is on the junction exit but its nose is aimed almost straight at a bale with a green 'O Petrol' flag right ahead; the open gravel lane runs up-frame and right, curving past more bales on the right shoulder.
decision.hypothesis: The car needs a modest right correction now to slip past the flag bale into the lane; at 13 mph a short W+D beat should move it without the full speed collapse seen on longer steers.
decision.memory: Bales flank the exit in a staggered line, so the lane weaves between them; the driving line drifts right as the road climbs toward the barn. Keep steers short (0.7-0.8 s) at 13+ mph.
